newsitem.title: MEXICO: INSTANT VIEW - Mexico industrial production weak.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Mexico industrial production weak.

text.p: Mexico's weaker-than- expected industrial production in March and in the first quarter was due in large part to fewer working days, analysts said on Wednesday.

But at the same time, the numbers -- industrial production rose 4.2 percent in March, and 6.2 percent in the first quarter over the year -- show that first quarter gross domestic product will also be disappointing, they said.
"With the holidays, production went down. The March number was expected to be low, but it was much lower than expected," Sergio Martin, economist with ING Barings, said.
